t_advice_summary_textbox.text: For 1 and a half rounds, focus on the yellow baskets. Blue, orange, green and yellow which spells out BOGY. The red baskets are the opposite, so for the next two and a half rounds, focus on them.

vb_textbox.text: There are 4 or 5 rounds, you need to be quick to choose a gnome. You either receive a red or a yellow basket and they very much vary in the mushrooms you receive. Be quick, but take advantage of the rest periods offered.
